description: This file implements HTTP handlers for managing configuration schemas and configurations for agents within a UI context, including retrieval and setting of configurations with validation, and schema fetching based on agent and package IDs.

classes.name: ConfigHandler
classes.description: HTTP handler struct for configuration management operations related to agents.

methods.name: NewConfigHandler
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new ConfigHandler instance with the provided storage provider.

methods.name: GetConfigSchemaHandler
methods.description: HTTP handler to retrieve configuration schema for an agent and package.

methods.name: GetConfigHandler
methods.description: HTTP handler to fetch the current configuration of a specified agent and package.

methods.name: SetConfigHandler
methods.description: HTTP handler to set or update configuration data for an agent within a specified package, including validation.
